about: The only poster and photo values allowed in this public repository (Phases 17B and 17G). scripts/capture-ss-ge-fixture.mjs replaces real ones with these, src/adapters/ss-ge/fixtures.test.ts refuses any other, and tests build theirs from them (src/adapters/ss-ge/fakes.ts). A user id is userIdPrefix plus two digits; a photo's GUID is photoGuid; a phone is +995 then phoneNationalPrefix plus two digits.
